restated_task: Fix the regression in slugkit.slugify so that it lowercases the input, collapses any maximal run of non-ASCII-alphanumeric characters into a single hyphen, strips leading and trailing hyphens, returns an empty string when the input contains no ASCII letters or digits, treats non-ASCII letters as separators, raises TypeError for non-string inputs, and returns a string. The existing tests must continue to pass.

interface_contract.name: slugify
interface_contract.behavior: Returns a lowercase ASCII slug derived from text. The algorithm: convert text to lowercase; replace each maximal contiguous sequence of characters that are not in the set [a-z0-9] with a single hyphen ('-'); remove any leading or trailing hyphens; if the result is empty (i.e., the input contained no ASCII letters or digits), return the empty string. Non-ASCII letters (e.g., accented characters) are considered separators and are replaced by hyphens.
error_cases: TypeError: raised if text is not an instance of str.

acceptance_criteria: The return value is always a str instance.
out_of_scope: The implementer must not modify the existing tests in tests/.
The implementer must not change the function signature or the public API of slugkit.
The implementer must not add new dependencies or imports beyond what is already used (re module).
The implementer must not change the behavior for inputs that are already correctly handled by the existing tests (but must fix the regression for the cases described).
